beats: Stand beside each of three sacs and loosen its stitch.
data.consequences: Slow contractions return the figure to the entrance but keep released nests. Leaving early gives no quest progress; retry is free. Real companions are never harmed, healed or resurrected.
data.design: Tiny pale figure against an opened, breathing Chansey-like interior; sutures and trapped Natu shapes must be legible as the three objectives. An approved abrupt early body-horror rupture inside the console game, not an astral journey.

questions.question: Does the game have a wider connection to events outside it?

description: Pet House reveals itself as The Mending: a tiny pale figure enters a breathing Chansey-like body to release three Natu shapes from sutured sacs and leave through its mouth. The horror happens inside the boys’ fictional game.

sections: §31: Pet House, The Mending and the boundary between fiction and real companions.

name: The Mending
